2608.07460.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
2608.07460.paper_summary: While post-training improves the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), it generally lowers their output diversity and creativity, negatively impacting tasks that explicitly require creativity (e.g., story generation) as well as those that require it implicitly, e.g., reinforcement learning (RL). We instead propose CreativeInstruct, a scalable instruction-tuning method that teaches LLMs to balance creative, base-model-like generations with the quality of post-trained models, by learning to inject special [StartCreativity] spans that bias generation toward creativity. Furthermore, we introduce a structural diversity metric based on graph edit distance, which captures narrative level variation missed by purely lexical and semantic metrics. On narrative generation, CreativeInstruct matches or exceeds the diversity of both multi-model baselines and distilled variants of their outputs, without sacrificing quality or requiring multiple models at inference time. These results are mirrored in our human evaluation, where we find that annotators rate CreativeInstruct generations as more creative than the post-trained LLMs' generations in 70.3% of cases. We also show the benefits of creative models as a substrate for RL: GRPO applied to a CreativeInstruct checkpoint improves by ~4% on AMC and ~5% points on MATH over the same training applied to the post-trained checkpoint.
2608.07460.paper_summary_zh: 雖然後訓練提高了大型語言模型（LLMs）的能力，但通常會降低它們的輸出多樣性和創造力，對於明確需要創造力的任務（例如，故事生成）以及那些隱含需要創造力的任務（例如，強化學習（RL））產生負面影響。我們提出了CreativeInstruct，一種可擴展的指令調整方法，教導LLMs平衡創造性、類似基礎模型的生成與後訓練模型的質量，通過學習注入特殊的[StartCreativity]範圍來偏向創造性生成。此外，我們引入了一種基於圖編輯距離的結構多樣性度量，捕捉純粹詞彙和語義度量所忽略的敘事層級變化。在敘事生成方面，CreativeInstruct的多樣性與多模型基準和其輸出的蒸餾變體相匹配或超過，且不犧牲質量或在推理時需要多個模型。我們的人類評估結果也反映了這些結果，我們發現評註者在70.3%的案例中評價CreativeInstruct生成的內容比後訓練LLMs的生成更具創造性。我們還展示了創造性模型作為RL基礎的好處：將GRPO應用於CreativeInstruct檢查點在AMC上提高了約4%，在MATH上提高了約5個點，與將相同訓練應用於後訓練檢查點相比。
